questions.question: Zakir Hussain, the renowned tabla maestro, passed away at the age of 73 in the US. In which year was he awarded the Padma Vibhushan?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Tabla maestro Zakir Hussain passed away** at the age of 73 in a San Francisco hospital due to **idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis** after being in the ICU for two weeks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Zakir Hussain was the **eldest son of legendary tabla maestro Allah Rakha** and carried forward his father’s legacy by taking **tabla to the global stage.**
 
• He was renowned for his **rhythmic brilliance** and innovative musical collaborations, blending **Indian classical traditions with jazz** and other global genres.
 
• In a **groundbreaking 1973 project**, Hussain collaborated with **John McLaughlin**, violinist **L Shankar**, and percussionist **TH 'Vikku' Vinayakram**, pioneering an **Indian fusion music style.**
 
• Over his illustrious six-decade career, he collaborated with numerous **celebrated Indian and international artists.**
 
• Hussain earned **five Grammy Awards**, including **three at the 66th Grammy Awards in 2024.**
 
• He is among the few musicians to have been awarded all three **Padma Awards**: **Padma Shri (1988)**, **Padma Bhushan (2002)**, and **Padma Vibhushan (2023).**
 
• His family described him as **“one of the world’s most transcendent musicians.”**

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding antiparticles, recently seen in news:

1. Antiparticles are particles traveling backward in time according to quantum theory.

2. Human bodies produce antiparticles naturally during the decay of potassium-40.

3. Antiparticles are purely theoretical with no observable evidence.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• A recent study explored antimatter scarcity and the significance of antiparticles in understanding the matter-antimatter asymmetry in the universe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Antiparticles are interpreted as particles traveling backward in time, a concept derived from quantum mechanics and special relativity. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.** *
 
• Antiparticles like positrons are naturally produced in the human body during the decay of potassium-40, occurring every 20 seconds. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
 
• Antiparticles are not merely theoretical; their existence was confirmed through observations, such as Carl Anderson’s discovery of the positron in 1932.* **Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.*

questions.question: The Uttar Pradesh government has declared the Maha Kumbh area of ​​Prayagraj a new district, which will be known as Maha Kumbh Mela district. With the creation of the 'Mahakumbh Mela district,' how many districts are now in the Prayagraj division?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Sangam and surrounding areas in Prayagraj** have been officially declared the **‘Mahakumbh Mela district’** in preparation for the **Mahakumbh-2025**, a 45-day religious event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• With this, **Uttar Pradesh now has 76 districts**, up from the previous 75.
 
• A notification by District Magistrate **Ravindra Kumar Mandar** on December 1, 2024, detailed the new district’s boundaries, which include Sangam, four tehsils, and **67 designated areas**.
 
• The decision was based on the **November 25 state government order**, establishing the Mahakumbh Mela area as a separate district under **Section 12 of the Uttar Pradesh Revenue Code (Amendment) Act, 2016**.
 
• The declaration also allows for the appointment of **additional district magistrates** and managing cases within the new district.
 
• The **Mahakumbh Mela will be inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on **December 13, 2024**, with festivities beginning on **January 13, 2025** (Paush Purnima) and concluding on **February 26, 2025** (Magh Shivaratri).
 
• The Prayagraj division now includes **five districts**: Prayagraj, Pratapgarh, Kaushambi, Fatehpur, and the newly created **Mahakumbh Mela district**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Here Are The Key Dates For The Maha Kumbh Mela 2025**
 
• January 13, 2025: Paush Purnima
 
• January 14, 2025: Makar Sankranti (First Shahi Snan)
 
• January 29, 2025: Mauni Amavasya (Second Shahi Snan)
 
• February 3, 2025: Basant Panchami (Third Shahi Snan)
 
• February 4, 2025: Achla Saptami
 
• February 12, 2025: Maghi Purnima
 
• February 26, 2025: Maha Shivratri (Final Snan)

questions.question: Which railway lines' foundation was laid by President Droupadi Murmu in Odisha?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangriposi-Gorumahisani, Buramara-Chakulia, and Badampahar-Keonjhargarh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu laid the foundation for three new railway lines in Odisha.**
 
• The three lines are: Bangriposi-Gorumahisani, Buramara-Chakulia, and Badampahar-Keonjhargarh.
 
• The project aims to boost connectivity and socio-economic development in tribal-dominated areas.
 
• The foundation-laying ceremony also saw the presence of Odisha CM Mohan Charan Majhi, Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, and Union Tribal Affairs Minister Jual Oram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bangriposi-Gorumahisani, Buramara-Chakulia, and Badampahar-Keonjhargarh**: These are the specific railway lines that were part of the foundation-laying ceremony in Odisha.
 
• **Tribal-dominated districts:** The new railway lines aim to improve connectivity in Keonjhar and Mayurbhanj, which are areas with a significant tribal population.
 
• **Job opportunities:** The new railway lines are expected to create job opportunities and contribute to the socio-economic development of the region.
 
• **Other key projects include the Tribal Research and Development Centre, Dandbose Airport, and a new building for the Sub-Divisional Hospital in Rairangpur.**

questions.question: In which state has the Ratapani Tiger Reserve, India's 57th tiger reserve, been notified, 17 years after its approval by the National Tiger Conservation Authority?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Ratapani forest near Bhopal** has been declared **Madhya Pradesh's 8th tiger reserve** and the **57th in India,** covering **1,271.456 sq. km.** across Bhopal, Raisen, and Sehore districts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Home to over 70 tigers**, with **56 identified in the 2022 census**, it is the **closest tiger reserve to an international airport.**
 
• The reserve includes notable sites like the **Bhimbetka World Heritage Site** and **Salkanpur Temple**
 
• NTCA funding will support **wildlife conservation and better management**, along with **eco-development programs** to boost **ecotourism and local livelihoods**.
 
• Located in the **Vindhya hills**, it offers a significant **teak forest cover** and is under **50 km from Bhopal**, enhancing accessibility.
 
• Madhav National Park is also slated to become a tiger reserve soon, expanding the state's conservation efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** 7 Tiger Reserves in Madhya Pradesh**

 
 
• Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve
 
• Kanha Tiger Reserve
 
• Panna Tiger Reserve
 
• Pench Tiger Reserve
 
• Sanjay-Dubri Tiger Reserve
 
• Satpura Tiger Reserve
 
• Veerangana Durgavati Tiger

questions.question: What are ghost guns, recently seen in the news?

options.text: Privately made firearms that lack serial numbers, making them untraceable.
Firearms designed with advanced stealth technology for military use.
Guns used exclusively by ghost hunting agencies.
Old and antique firearms displayed in museums.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The term "ghost guns" gained attention recently when a U.S. murder suspect was found in possession of such a firearm. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Definition: Ghost guns can include pistols, revolvers, rifles, or other firearms that are privately assembled and unregistered.* Hence, option 1 is correct.** *
 
• Untraceable Nature: As they lack serial numbers, ghost guns bypass traditional tracking systems and background checks, posing significant challenges for law enforcement.
 
• Rising Use: The U.S. Department of Justice reported recovering 19,273 ghost guns in 2021, up from 8,504 in 2020, indicating a sharp increase in their use.

questions.question: Who launched the Jago Grahak Jago App, Jagriti App, and Jagriti Dashboard on National Consumer Day?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Consumer Affairs.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Department of Consumer Affairs** launched the **Jago Grahak Jago App**, **Jagriti App**, and **Jagriti Dashboard** on **National Consumer Day.**
 
• The initiative aims to enhance consumer protection and promote awareness of digital safety.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jago Grahak Jago App** alerts users about **unsafe URLs** during online activities.
 
• The **Jagriti App** allows users to report URLs suspected of hosting **illegal dark patterns.**
 
• Complaints received via the **Jagriti App** will be addressed by the **Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• About National Consumer Day:__

 __
 
• Observed annually on **24th December** to promote consumer awareness.
 
• Highlights the enactment of the **Consumer Protection Act, 1986.**
 
 
 
• About the CCPA:__
 
 
• The **Central Consumer Protection Authority** is tasked with regulating consumer rights and addressing grievances.
